headline: Khaitan & Co advises Tata Capital on majority stake acquisition in YOGLOANS
sum: Tata Capital Limited has acquired a 88.6% majority stake in Kerala-based Yogakshemam Loans Limited, dba YOGLOANS. Khaitan & Co advised Tata Capital on this stake acquisition.
detail: Tata Capital Limited has acquired a 88.6% majority stake in Kerala-based Yogakshemam Loans Limited, dba YOGLOANS. Khaitan & Co advised Tata Capital on this stake acquisition. The transaction team consisted of Surbhi Kejriwal (Partner), Vidushi Gupta (Partner), Vedika Bhandari (Principal Associate), Bimbita Kateel (Principal Associate), Arnav Bose (Senior Associate), Vivek Badkur (Senior Associate), and Nikhil Singh (Senior Associate). Yoagloans, for dealstreet Based in Kerala, YOGLOANS is an RBI-registered Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing fast, hassle-free, and affordable financial solutions, including loans for two-wheelers and other needs.
